_comment: Global root config - project-wide settings the deployment owner controls, embedded into the edge bundle at deploy time (see _shared/price-cap.ts). Not user-editable; change a value here and redeploy. modelPriceCaps caps the per-1,000,000-token USD price of any model a user-triggered chat may run; null on a dimension means no ceiling on that side. Caps are matched against Venice's live /models pricing.
